iconicAnchor.label: Pop Art's transformation of mass-media imagery
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The movement anchor establishes ordinary products, advertising, comics, celebrity, serial repetition, and mechanical-looking print processes as critical subjects and methods.

sources.title: Pop Art
supports: Pop artists appropriated the visual language and subjects of mass culture, including consumer goods, advertising, celebrity, and comics.

sources.title: Ben-Day dots
supports: Visible mechanical dots, flat separation color, and enlargement can make commercial reproduction itself part of the image.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set.
